about: Proposed region definitions for detailed maps of Denmark: its 5 regions, one map region each. A proposal for discussion (docs/REGIONS-DK.md); no code reads this file, and it does not ship.

codes.proposal: ISO 3166-2:DK codes DK-81 to DK-85, the level closest to a US state.
codes.why: A bare DK is not in STATE_CODES (engine/address_search.py). The parts after the hyphen are two digits, while address index ids must match [A-Z]{2} (engine/setup/manifest.py line 72, engine/setup/install.py line 267), the same question REGIONS-TH.md raises for TH-10.
codes.same_digits: The two digits are the last two of the DAGI and CPR region code (1081 to 1085), valid from 1 January 2007 (Danmarks Statistik, opened), and StatBank's 081 to 085.
codes.iso_checked: search only: iso.org refused automated reading (HTTP 403), as for the other proposals.
codes.not_included: Greenland (GL) and the Faroe Islands (FO) are parts of the Danish realm with home rule, but Geofabrik, Overture and the Danish address register all treat them apart from Denmark (opened). They are not proposed here.
codes.pr_84: PR #84 lists all of Denmark as one map, eu-dk, boxed by Geofabrik's outline (7.7011, 54.4406, 15.6545, 58.0624).
codes.pr_35: PR #35 has a box for Copenhagen, dk-kob (12.26, 55.38, 12.86, 55.98), cut from the same extract.

totals.dagi_summary: 98 kommuner, 5 regioner, 1100 postnumre, 7849 supplerende bynavne (Klimadatastyrelsen, Danmarks Administrative Geografiske Inddeling; opened)

box_caveats: GISCO's terms allow use of its NUTS boundaries with the credit '© EuroGeographics for the administrative boundaries', and are read as non-commercial (search only). The boxes are four numbers each, but before a build they should be recomputed from DAGI, the national boundary register (CC BY 4.0), which now needs a free Datafordeler key.
Cross-check against OpenStreetMap's region relations (Nominatim; ODbL): every edge agrees within about 0.03 degree, except that OSM's Region Hovedstaden ends at 15.157° E and leaves out Ertholmene.
The boxes overlap: DK-85's padded box holds most of mainland DK-84, and DK-82's holds Vejle (DK-83).

osm_extract.outline: denmark.poly, one ring of 80 points, 7.70 to 15.65° E, 54.44 to 58.06° N. Christiansø is inside; Malmö, Helsingborg, Ystad, Flensburg and Kiel are outside.

changes_in_2026.dawa_closed: DAWA, the free address and boundary API that most open Danish tooling used (api.dataforsyningen.dk, dawa.aws.dk), closed on 1 October 2026; its endpoints now answer HTTP 410 Gone (opened). The replacements are Adressevælger for address lookup and Datafordeler for everything else.
changes_in_2026.datafordeler_key: Datafordeler's DAGI WFS and GraphQL answer 401 without a key (opened). A key is free with a login and is valid for 2 years (search only). Downloads of the elevation model, GeoDanmark and place names are listed as needing a key too (opened for DHM).
changes_in_2026.agency_name: SDFI became Klimadatastyrelsen on 14 August 2024, and Klimadatastyrelsen merges with DMI on 1 December 2026 into 'DMI, Kort og Grunddata' (opened). Credits will need the new name.

CC-BY-4.0-KDS.name: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0, for Klimadatastyrelsen's free geographic data and the free basic data on Datafordeler
CC-BY-4.0-KDS.since: 2024-05-16, replacing the 2022 'Vilkår for brug af frie geografiske data'
CC-BY-4.0-KDS.attribution: 'Du skal kreditere Klimadatastyrelsen på et passende sted' (credit Klimadatastyrelsen in a suitable place). No fixed wording. The superseded 2022 text fixed one: 'Indeholder data fra Styrelsen for Dataforsyning og Infrastruktur, [dataset], [month year]'.
CC-BY-4.0-KDS.covers: DAGI, DHM, Danske Stednavne, GeoDanmark, DAR and others

terrain.format: GeoTIFF in 10 x 10 km tiles; about a fifth of the country is flown again each year
terrain.notes: 0.4 m is far finer than zoom 12, the deepest zoom tools/build_terrain.py writes; it would be resampled. The file size for the whole country was not obtained (Dataforsyningen's pages need JavaScript).

dams_and_dikes.dataset: Kystbeskyttelsesanlæg (coastal protection works, including type 'Dige', dike)
dams_and_dikes.verified: 2026-11-17 (metadata opened; the WFS answered HTTP 500 that day)
dams_and_dikes.notes: Added to quarterly and described as 'not dimension-true'. Denmark has no dam register like the NID: the risk is storm surge and coastal flooding, so dikes are the nearer equivalent. No kind for a dike exists in water.sqlite today.

storm_surge.dataset: Flood-directive risk areas and a 40 cm watercourse-flood grid

crops.dataset: Marker 2026 (declared field parcels with crop code)
crops.verified: 2026-11-17 (download listing and HEAD opened; licence not found, contents not opened)
crops.notes: Years 2008 to 2026 are listed. Markblokke_2026.zip answered 404. The 2026 crop code list is dated 25 February 2026. Orchard, berry and vine codes were not mapped to the kinds crops.sqlite uses.

buildings.notes: Outlines with building type and a link to BBR; no height attribute. buildings.sqlite stores a height, so heights would come from OSM or from DHM/Overflade minus DHM/Terræn.

buildings.dataset: BBR, the building and dwelling register
buildings.notes: Storeys (byg054) and construction year (byg026); no building height found.

places.dataset: Danske Stednavne (about 140,000 names in 25 categories and 217 subtypes)

addresses.licence: CC-BY-4.0-KDS ('Som bruger af frie grunddata er du underlagt CC BY 4.0', terms of 16 May 2024)

addresses.attribution: Contains data from the Danish Agency for Data Supply and Infrastructure... Distributed by OpenAddresses. Accessed: 2026-10-15
addresses.notes: Overture takes Denmark from OpenAddresses' sources/dk/countrywide.json, a single upload of 27 March 2026 (56,689,209 bytes) drawn from DAR. With DAWA closed it will not refresh by itself; whether it is refreshed was not found.

not_open_nationwide: Defibrillators: hjertestarter.dk (TrygFonden) allows reuse only by prior agreement (https://hjertestarter.dk/vilkaar, opened). OSM has 2,775 emergency=defibrillator.
Public warning sirens: about 1,000, covering about 80 % of the urban population; no list of locations is published (Beredskabsstyrelsen, page of 7 April 2025, opened). OSM has 38 emergency=siren.
Shelters (sikringsrum): no public list. A national survey began on 16 September 2026 and is due in 2027 (mssb.dk, opened).
Building heights: neither GeoDanmark nor BBR has one (see buildings).
Crop parcels: Marker 2026 is downloadable without an account, but no licence was found.

addressing.order: Street name, house number, then floor and door, then postcode and town: 'Rådhuspladsen 1, 1550 København V'. A supplementary town name (supplerende bynavn) goes on its own line between the street line and the postcode line.
addressing.house_number: 1 to 999, optionally followed by a capital letter A to Z with no space; I, J, O and Q are not used in new numbers.
addressing.floor: st (ground floor), then 1 to 99; kl for the basement and k2 for the level below it.
addressing.door: tv (left), th (right) or mf (middle); or 1, 2, 3 numbered from the left; or up to 4 characters from a-z, 0-9 and hyphen.

postal_code.format: Four digits, 1050 to 9990 in the address data.
postal_code.relation_to_regions: Postcodes are set under the Postal Act with 'ingen automatisk sammenhæng' (no automatic connection) to administrative boundaries (danmarksadresser.dk, opened). In the OpenAddresses copy of DAR (27 March 2026; 3,933,406 rows; 1,089 postcodes), 38 postcodes cross a region boundary, for example 7100 Vejle with 921 addresses in Midtjylland and 9500 Hobro with 789. An index per region must be cut by municipality code, not by postcode.
postal_code.postal_districts: Copenhagen, Aarhus, Odense and Aalborg postcodes carry a district letter or two after the town: København K, N, NV, S, SV, V, Ø; Aarhus C, N, V; Odense C, M, N, NV, NØ, S, SV, SØ, V; Aalborg SV, SØ, Øst (addr:city values with more than 200 uses in the Denmark extract, taginfo, 2026-11-17).

addressing.letters: Street and town names use æ, ø and å, and older spellings write å as aa: 695 street names contain aa and 4,499 contain å, and twenty postal towns use Aa (Aarhus, Aalborg, Aabenraa, Faaborg). Some names also hold ä, ö, ü or é.

current_code.read: engine/address_search.py, 17 November 2026, by calling its functions
current_code.is_address_query: Needs the query to start with a digit, so 'Rådhuspladsen 1, 1550 København V' and 'Nørrebrogade 20, 2. th, 2200 København N' are not treated as addresses.
current_code.normalize: Keeps only a-z and 0-9: 'København' becomes 'k benhavn', 'Århus' becomes 'rhus', 'Ærøskøbing' becomes 'r sk bing'. Århus and Aarhus never meet.
current_code.postcode: _parts() reads only a five-digit last word; a Danish postcode stays in the street words.
current_code.state_guess: A last word equal to a US state code is taken for a state: '12 Tomsgårdsvej 2400 København NV' is searched in Nevada. NV is a postal district in København and Odense.
